requirements.short: Pursuing a B.S. or M.S. in a quantitative field
requirements.text: The candidate is pursuing a B.S. or M.S. in computer science, statistics, data science or a related field.
The candidate has experience with SQL and Python, including pandas.
The candidate has designed or analyzed experiments, for example A/B tests and significance testing.
The candidate is familiar with machine learning libraries such as scikit-learn.

requirements.short: Explain results to a non-technical audience
requirements.text: The candidate can explain results clearly to a non-technical audience.

requirements.short: Dashboards, for example in Streamlit or Tableau
requirements.text: The candidate has built dashboards, for example with Streamlit or Tableau.

added: Projects
Checkout A/B Test
Designed an A/B test of two checkout flows on a mock store, choosing the sample size of 8,000 sessions per variant with a power calculation before running it.
Analyzed the A/B test in Python with a two-proportion z-test (statsmodels) to check significance; the one-page flow raised conversion from 3.1% to 3.7% (p = 0.03).
Built a Streamlit dashboard that shows daily conversion and a 95% confidence interval for each variant.
Wrote a one-page memo with a recommendation for a non-technical audience of classmates who had not taken the
course.
Subscription Churn Model
Engineered 12 features from the customer table in SQL, such as tenure and support-call counts.
Trained logistic regression and gradient-boosted models in scikit-learn to predict which subscribers cancel, reaching 0.84 AUC on a held-out set.
Built a Tableau dashboard that ranks customers by churn risk and shows churn by plan type.
Wrote the analysis up in a Jupyter notebook with a plain-language summary for readers who do not work with data.
Retail Sales Dashboard
Loaded 1.2 million order rows into SQLite and wrote 8 SQL queries on sales, returns and repeat purchases.
Charted weekly revenue by region and product category in Tableau.
Found that 4 of the 31 product categories brought in 58% of revenue.
Campus Dining Recommender
Built a content-based recommender over 600 menu items using TF-IDF and cosine similarity in Python.
Surveyed 45 classmates to evaluate it; 62% of its top-5 picks were rated 4 stars or higher.
Wrote SQL queries that turn order data into a weekly sales report by product, which the owner used to decide what to stock.
